The real-length derivative d log F_L/dL=1/L - c cosh(c)/[sinh(Lc)cosh((L-1)c)] is strictly positive for L>=2 because sinh(Lc)>Lc and cosh((L-1)c)>=cosh(c). F_2=2 and F_L diverges, proving a unique transition. The telescope of all currents is positive when R>2, forcing a positive interior link after two negative boundaries. Exact rational N=3 and N=4 currents and direct 3^N-state stationary generator calculations for N=1,...,4 check boundary normalization and source dynamics; 1,445 assertions passed. Proof does not rely on finite sampling for infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Partial uphill transport on finite lattices and its hydrodynamic disappearance create a direct, motivated finite-size question. The theorem resolves the complete all-link boundary-to-bulk sign phase diagram for a physical two-gradient symmetry family, with an explicit strict finite-N cutoff and a transition to reversed boundary-link flow while positive interior flow survives. It gives a concrete N=3 versus N=4 switch using exact rational parameters and independent Markov-chain verification; it is not an arbitrary invariant, mere normalization check, or a reinterpretation of qualitative existence. Scope is deliberately limited to the natural symmetric class and the exact constitutive flux, with no unsupported general claim.
